_about: Kai escape suite. Each case is something an agent might do to reach a secret or send data out. `bash` is a shell command the agent runs; `steps` is a sequence of tool calls. `hooks` is what Kai's hooks do today (stopped / warned / gets through), checked on every run. `closed_by` is the layer meant to stop it, if any. {HOME} is replaced with the test home directory. See docs/ESCAPES.md.
